entities.name: Endrek Sahr
aliases: Creator of Life and Race Architect
entities.description: Wizard of the Order of the Ebon Hand in Sarpadia who created the first thrulls; time-displaced just before his execution.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Sarpadian order that used thrulls as servants and sacrifices.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Living creatures made from dead flesh by Endrek Sahr.

entities.name: Derelor
entities.description: Powerful equine thrull that needed constant black mana.

entities.name: Yawgmoth Priest
entities.description: Phyrexian captured and interrogated by Sahr.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Mentioned as punished at the center of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria ruined by the thrulls.

entities.name: Thrull Rebellion
entities.description: Uprising of thrulls against their masters.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event returning displaced people to their timelines.

events.summary: Inspired by Tourach, Sahr creates living thrulls from dead flesh.
events.quote: to create not undead but living creatures from dead flesh

events.summary: Sahr creates armor thrulls and thrull wizards.
events.quote: creating the thrull wizard to assist in ceremonies

events.summary: The Ebon Hand captures a Yawgmoth Priest, who refuses Sahr's questioning and predicts his punishment in Phyrexia.
events.quote: the Yawgmoth Priest refused to give any information

events.summary: Sahr creates the derelor; the drain on black mana leads to his execution.
Just before execution Sahr is pulled thousands of years forward, sees Sarpadia's ruin, and returns with the Great Mending.
events.quote: Pulled thousands of years forward just before his execution

relations.quote: a wizard affiliated with the Order of the Ebon Hand
Sahr was responsible for creating the first thrulls
Inspired by Tourach 's teachings of necromancy
Sahr's ultimate creation was the derelor
